style: Original 4:3 photorealistic food, pale oak, beige linen, natural side light, same clear processor with black base, ivory bowls and shallow gray freezer container; no text, logos, hands, people or collage
first: Washed strawberries drying, cottage cheese and empty food processor
stages: Clean dry hulled strawberries on a pale wooden board: most cut into halves in one small bowl and a smaller reserved portion chopped into tiny pieces in a separate ivory ramekin. Knife resting safely, green tops discarded apart. Same clear food processor bowl with matte black base and cottage cheese bowl in background. This stage separates fruit for blending and folding.

The SAME small clear food processor bowl on its matte black base now contains smooth thick WHITE cottage cheese cream after blending cottage cheese with honey, a little lemon juice and vanilla. No curds remaining, lid set safely beside it, machine off. A small clear honey bowl and a lemon half nearby. No strawberries blended in yet.

The SAME clear food processor bowl and matte black base now contain a smooth thick PALE STRAWBERRY PINK cream after blending most of the strawberries into the cottage cheese base. Tiny natural strawberry seed flecks, no bright artificial pink, no ice cream scoops yet. Small reserved ramekin of chopped strawberries beside it.

In a wide shallow ivory mixing bowl, the pale strawberry pink cottage cheese cream is being folded with small reserved strawberry pieces using a pale silicone spatula resting in the bowl. Same clear food processor bowl with pink residue in background, machine off. No extra fruits, no nuts, no whipped cream.

A shallow rectangular LIGHT GRAY freezer-safe food container, about 16 by 20 cm, filled with the pale strawberry pink cream and tiny berry pieces, surface leveled smoothly. A clear tight-fitting snap lid sits next to it, ready to cover. On pale oak counter beside beige linen. No ice scoops yet, no frosted frozen texture yet.

The SAME shallow rectangular light gray container of strawberry cottage cheese ice cream, now covered with its clear lid on a clean freezer shelf. Pink mixture inside partly frozen, with a few gentle spatula swirl marks from stirring. Very light frost in freezer, no other products or packaging. No words or visible brand marks.

Inviting hero photo: TWO natural scoops of pale strawberry pink cottage cheese ice cream in a small shallow ivory dessert bowl, tiny strawberry flecks and small fruit pieces visible within the creamy scoops. No other garnish, no sauce, no cookies, no whipped cream. Silver dessert spoon beside bowl. The same light gray freezer container with scoop marks and pink ice cream softly blurred behind on pale oak counter, beige linen, warm side window light. Ice cream freshly softened for scooping, not melting into soup, realistic homemade texture. Finished recipe cover.
